entries.speaker: Motivated First-Year
entries.en: Hey, wasn't that Sakamoto-senpai?[n]I saw him going up the stairs...

entries.speaker: Energetic First-Year
entries.en: Maybe he called someone up there[n]so he can punch them.

entries.speaker: Motivated First-Year
entries.en: Oh, do you mean like what happened[n]at track practice last year? I heard it[n]was a big fight...

entries.speaker: Energetic First-Year
entries.en: Stay away from him! We only just[n]started high school... I'm too young[n]to die!

entries.speaker: Proper First-Year
entries.en: There have been far too many[n]accidents lately.

entries.speaker: Proper First-Year
entries.en: What's the point of waking up early[n]if my train's just going to get to[n]the station late?

entries.speaker: Gossiping First-Year
entries.en: You mean accidents like that train[n]engineer going crazy, right?

entries.speaker: Gossiping First-Year
entries.en: I saw a photo of him online...[n]His face was totally messed up.

entries.speaker: Gossiping First-Year
entries.en: Plus I heard some kid's parents were[n]on that train and are in critical[n]condition now...

entries.speaker: Proper First-Year
entries.en: D-Don't be so gullible.

entries.speaker: Scared Male Student
entries.en: Have you seen that transfer student[n]everyone's talking about? How does[n]he look? Tough?

entries.speaker: Talkative Male Student
entries.en: Nah, I heard he actually dresses[n]kinda plain.

entries.speaker: Scared Male Student
entries.en: He's probably just hiding his true[n]self under that. I'll make sure not[n]to cross him...

entries.speaker: Talkative Male Student
entries.en: Yeah, I bet he's a totally different[n]person when he's mad. I heard he[n]almost killed someone.

entries.speaker: Injured Female Student
entries.en: It still kind of hurts...
Did something happen?
Let me through.

entries.speaker: Injured Female Student
entries.en: Huh...?

entries.speaker: Injured Female Student
entries.en: Oh, no... I'm okay. I've just been spacing[n]out a little...

entries.speaker: Injured Female Student
entries.en: Oh, am I in the way...? Sorry, I've just[n]been spacing out a little bit lately...

entries.speaker: Injured Female Student
entries.en: Wait... Are you that new[n]transfer student from Class D?
Surprised you recognize me.
You've got the wrong guy.

entries.speaker: Injured Female Student
entries.en: Well, everyone has been talking[n]about you...

entries.speaker: Injured Female Student
entries.en: Don't worry about the rumors though.[n]I'm sure they're just surprised for now.

entries.speaker: Injured Female Student
entries.en: Huh? You don't need to lie.

entries.speaker: Injured Female Student
entries.en: By the way, I don't mind what they[n]say in the rumors. I wouldn't[n]believe that stuff without proof.

entries.speaker: Injured Female Student
entries.en: ...A lot of people misunderstand[n]my best friend because of how[n]she looks too.

entries.speaker: Injured Female Student
entries.en: It's not good to assume you know[n]a person just by looking at them,[n]don't you think?

entries.speaker: Injured Female Student
entries.en: Well, if you even need help,[n]I'd be glad to—

entries.speaker: Injured Female Student
entries.en: Ow... Not again...
Where is the rooftop?
Are you hurt?

entries.speaker: Injured Female Student
entries.en: Oh, um... It's right up these stairs.

entries.speaker: Injured Female Student
entries.en: Oh, yeah... I kind of hurt my shoulder[n]during volleyball.

entries.speaker: Injured Female Student
entries.en: But, um... I'm all right. Don't worry[n]about me.

entries.speaker: Injured Female Student
entries.en: Well, sorry for stopping you[n]so suddenly here.

entries.speaker: Injured Female Student
entries.en: I should be getting to practice,[n]so... see you around.

entries.speaker: Injured Female Student
entries.en: I have to hurry to practice... I'll be[n]in trouble if I don't get there on time.

entries.speaker: Injured Female Student
entries.en: I wonder if running away will solve[n]all my problems...

entries.speaker: Gentle Teacher
entries.en: By the way, thank you for volunteering to[n]take care of the planters.

entries.speaker: Mature Third-Year
entries.en: Oh, it's no trouble. I'm not sure I'm up to[n]the task though...

entries.speaker: Gentle Teacher
entries.en: Don't worry. You're being a huge help.

entries.speaker: Gentle Teacher
entries.en: Oh, and I'll make sure the roof is unlocked[n]for you... I imagine it's going to be a lot of[n]work, but I'm sure you can handle it.

entries.speaker: Mature Third-Year
entries.en: Alright, I'll do my best! I'll go take a look at[n]them later.
